hooks.text: 同屏可出现数百名敌人，以高密度持续围攻构成核心生存压力。
hooks.excerpt: Fend against vast enemy forces, reaching hundreds of foes on screen at any given time
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三百多种被动升级与五十多种武器共同构成大规模跑局构筑池。
hooks.excerpt: Make your build from more than 300+ passive upgrades and 50+ weapons.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 路线选择允许主动挑战强敌或前往商店休整，让玩家决定Rog每段冒险的风险节奏。
hooks.excerpt: You can choose which path Rog takes. Feel brave enough to take on a powerful foe, or would you prefer to rest at the shop? The choice is yours!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
